title: Data Insights Analyst
text: Data Insights Analyst at Talent – Winner ‘Seek Large Recruitment Agency of the Year’ 3 consecutive years! (Melbourne, Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Our client is a leader in their field. They have a fabulous culture, modern work environment, and a relaxed positive culture. They are currently going through growth and a digital shift and require a Digital Insight Analyst to join their marketing team to assist with the uplift, collating, forward planning and gathering of data from all sources related to digital marketing, customer experience, social media, and e-commerce to achieve the vision and the organisational growth. Your skills will be highly regarded and you will have an opportunity to make a difference with your previous experience and thus will influence other team members. As a mid-level Digital Insights Analyst, you will support a variety of innovative programs and work with a number of teams and people across the business. You will be setting up standardised and consistent data implementations and reporting across multiple functions while supporting the marketing managers and the Head of Digital by tracking across all marketing and campaign activities and then analysing and reporting on the effectiveness of the campaigns. To apply for this fabulous opportunity you will need the following skills and experience: Previous experience as a Digital Insights Analyst Experience with Google Analytics Experience with Power BI, Firebase and Social Studio would be preferred Experience with a variety of analytical tools Excellent interpersonal skills For more information please call Shelley on 03 9…show number . Please send your confidential resume ASAP. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly.
